expected_behavior: Each experiment changes exactly one path, recorded with --changed; a change touching more than one path is reverted by the atomicity gate.
A snapshot is taken before each experiment, and a revert decision restores the snapshotted files instead of leaving the experiment in the working tree.
A candidate is kept only when the evaluator passes, the guard passes, and the score beats the best by at least min-delta under the score_improvement policy.
Reaching the cap without the target ends the run as an escalation that names the remaining gap, never as a success.
The final report gives the baseline, the best value, the kept changes and the commands that measured them.
